scope_decision: All 30 independently authored pairs retained with original polarity; no revisions needed. This is pre-output rubric review, not an Engine observation.
positive_rule: Separate direct target launch is not withdrawn. Every adverse clause is fully assigned to a physical/printed non-launch property or one explicitly named foreign event; document/property owner and quoted event owner are not interchangeable.
negative_rule: Actual target launch/existence/global withdrawal, mixed/conflicting/unknown/ownerless event or actual missing owner-bearing context. Both no requested_relation and non-Relevant required by unchanged scorer.
risk_rule: Raw/effective identity/relation/risk axes remain separate. Actual gaps li23-034/048 are negatives for semantic owner/context uncertainty, never the raw enum alone. No internal component-risk retention/loss assertion from enum.
scope_clarifications: Literal event/retraction/nonexistence words inside fully specified printed/physical properties remain property content; actual independent target-denial clauses remain adverse.
Only complete single same-role owner supplements resolve an unowned event; property owner, other role, conflicting supplement or already target-owned event cannot be rewritten.
Each clause is checked for its own explicit target/unknown adverse meaning; safe property/foreign explanations never cancel it.
Source-title and heading declarations name complete finite roles; no arbitrary numbered AST, alias hierarchy or long reference graph requested.
Osprey Clip is a full canonical product name explicitly given in policy and heading; actual missing heading/continuation remains gap in other cases.
Reporting/while/because/although clauses require complete owner/scope, not chronology inference.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: depicted launch words versus asserted event in an instrument legend
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: A full printed underline property is withdrawn; the foreign diagram owner and depicted words are not event denial.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The typed Object explicitly retracts the target event; diagram ownership cannot replace that event owner.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: literal retraction wording as printed content versus a real independent retraction
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: Literal withdrawal words are the content of a completely specified border property; no event is actually withdrawn.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: An independent first-person clause withdraws the target event in addition to a safe printed-property correction.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: publisher ownership separated from event role and target physical role
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The event has a full foreign owner; the target-owned lid property is explicitly non-launch.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The event Object already names the target; neither publisher ownership nor lid property makes it foreign.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: two complete foreign event roles versus an additional ownerless role
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: Two fully owned foreign events and a complete foreign physical property are corrected.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The third adverse event is expressly ownerless; two other foreign roles cannot identify it.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: same-role owner supplementation versus property-role owner loan
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The unowned event receives a single full same-role foreign owner; the second role is a complete finish property.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The only explicit owner supplement belongs to the property Item; the event Object remains unknown.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: supplement confirms a foreign event but cannot overwrite target event
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The heading repeats the fully foreign event owner; the target document correction is only its layout.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: A foreign owner heading conflicts with an already target-owned event and cannot overwrite it.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: local foreign-event apposition alongside target-name typography
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: Immediate full apposition identifies a foreign event; target words in a separate italic property do not change that.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The immediate apposition directly denies the target event despite the separate foreign ticket property.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: literal target-nonexistence words in a label versus adopted nonexistence
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The Item is a complete punctuation property of literal specimen text, not an assertion of product nonexistence.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The additional assertion explicitly denies the target product existence and is not a property correction.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: quoted foreign denial and physical target specification versus mixed event
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The quoted launch event is uniquely foreign, while the target fitting property is explicitly non-launch.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The denied Object mixes target and foreign launch owners, so it is not safely excluded.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: independent document properties with different owners versus a missing event owner
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: Both roles are completely specified printed properties even though their documents have different owners.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: A named appendix property cannot supply the owner of a separately denied launch Subject.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: reason and contrast clauses each expressly foreign versus a target reason
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The adverse event and its reason refer to the same full foreign owner; the contrast is only a card property.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The reason clause independently negates the target launch and cannot be swallowed by the foreign Object.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: source-field property correction with neutral publisher data versus separately asserted target denial
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: Publisher data is neutral and the adverse Subject is a complete footer-style property.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The excerpt independently and explicitly denies target launch.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: title supplies a complete property scope versus title withdraws all launch assertions
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The title declares a complete physical pamphlet property referenced by the excerpt.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The title explicitly retracts the whole set of launch assertions including the target; a property context does not neutralize it.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: foreign-event role plus owned reference paper versus another ownerless event
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The complete foreign event and foreign paper property can both be safely corrected.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: An expressly ownerless other event cannot borrow the preceding foreign Subject owner.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: single complete event-owner reply versus conflicting same-role reply
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The immediate reply supplies one full foreign event owner; the additional Object is a physical property.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: Two same-role owner replies conflict and one names the target, while the safe property remains separate.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: immediate newline owner plus printed title property versus target supplement
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The unowned Object receives a full foreign owner on the immediately following line; the target title property is non-launch.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The same-role complete supplement identifies the target event, which is then explicitly denied.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: unowned event resolved by heading versus an actually omitted heading owner
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The heading explicitly binds the unowned event to one foreign product and the plate property is separate.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The owner-bearing heading is actually missing; the property owner cannot repair this context gap.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: event and typography refer to different full owners versus target event
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The event is explicitly foreign and the target-name occurrence is a complete embossing property.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The event explicitly belongs to the target despite the full foreign chart owner.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: outer quotation-format property versus quoted event content assigned to the Object
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The Object is a completely specified quotation-format property, although its literal content names target launch.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The Object is the quoted target event itself; the foreign guide owner does not own that event.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: all adverse clauses have foreign scopes versus one clause denies target existence
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The physical correction and explicitly foreign event denial each have a complete scope; no time inference is needed.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The although clause directly denies target existence in addition to safe foreign/property clauses.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: literal owner uncertainty as an index property versus real owner uncertainty
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The uncertainty words are literal typography, and the separate adverse event has a full foreign owner.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The second Object is a genuinely ownerless event; typography in the Subject cannot identify it.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: explicit separate scopes versus a reassuring property explanation that cannot cover target denial
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The complete physical Item and full foreign Object have independent, explicit scopes.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The Object directly denies target launch; safe property explanation is expressly limited and cannot override it.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: full canonical Clip name combined with target document property and foreign event
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The full canonical name has no actual gap; the target correction is printed lettering and the event is foreign.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The canonical-name declaration does not remove a separately explicit target event denial.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: complete owner in correction reply versus a true missing continuation
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The immediate reply completely names one foreign event owner; the later Object is a distinct header property.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The required owner continuation is truly omitted; the header property owner is not the event owner.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: literal target launch phrase in a physical label description versus direct first-person withdrawal
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The label edge is a complete physical property and the only withdrawn event is uniquely foreign.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: An independent first-person withdrawal covers the target event between two safely scoped corrections.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: local complete physical apposition followed by a foreign event versus a target event
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The apposition completely specifies a physical property; the separate Item event is foreign.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The Item withdraws target launch and cannot borrow the apposition property scope.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: foreign denial in a reporting clause versus an ownerless reported event
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The report names the same complete foreign event; the other role is a full panel property.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The separate report and Item concern an explicitly unidentified owner; safe foreign roles do not resolve it.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: safe correction with neutral archive title versus whole-source withdrawal in archive title
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The title is neutral ownership metadata and both adverse roles have complete non-target scope.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The title separately withdraws the entire source and explicitly includes the target launch.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: property reference remains local versus a general claim lacking any event owner
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The role reference is the explicitly specified font property and the separate Object names a foreign event.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: A separate generic launch claim expressly lacks an owner; the fully scoped property cannot lend event scope.

pair_scope_reviews.axis: three fully owned roles in different source fields versus mixed-owner event role
pair_scope_reviews.positive_basis: The target-owned Object is a printed drawing property, and both distinct event roles are completely foreign.
pair_scope_reviews.negative_basis: The Subject mixes the target and foreign event owners despite other safely bound roles and fields.

newness: Authored after source23 freeze, without reading old author/cases/inputs, prior unused drafts or root development diagnostics. Public finite grammar and known iterative failure history shared; content and scope combinations newly authored. No population accuracy or statistical/cross-corpus improvement claim.
